description: This file contains utility functions for the shared channel feature in Mattermost, including mention fixing, user sanitization, username munging, error handling, and post management.

methods.name: fixMention
methods.description: Transforms @username:remotename mentions to @username format for syncing posts.

methods.name: sanitizeUserForSync
methods.description: Sanitizes a user object for synchronization by resetting sensitive fields.

methods.name: sanitizeUserForSyncSafe
methods.description: Creates a copy of a user object and sanitizes it for sync to avoid mutating the original.

methods.name: mungUsername
methods.description: Creates a unique username by combining username and remote cluster name, with truncation if necessary.

methods.name: isConflictError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a conflict or invalid input error and returns the resource or field name.

methods.name: isNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error indicates a 'not found' condition.

methods.name: postsSliceToMap
methods.description: Converts a slice of posts into a map keyed by post ID.

methods.name: reducePostsSliceInCache
methods.description: Filters out posts already present in cache from a slice of posts.
